sentences.en: Babies grow up inside the amniotic fluid in the womb.
sentences.zh: 胎儿在羊水中子宫内成长。

sentences.en: A woman had a baby after receiving a womb transplant.
sentences.zh: 一位女性在接受子宫移植后生下了孩子。

sentences.en: Sami murdered Layla and cut her baby from her womb.
sentences.zh: 萨米杀害了莱拉，并从她的子宫中割下了婴儿。
